examples.english: I attend English conversation lessons twice a week.

notes:
レッスン refers to a period of instruction, typically for skills like music, dance, or language.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- レッスンを{受|う}ける: to take lessons
- レッスンに{通|かよ}う: to attend lessons regularly
- レッスン{料|りょう}: lesson fee
- {個人|こじん}レッスン: private lesson
- グループレッスン: group lesson

COMMON TYPES:
- ピアノのレッスン: piano lessons
- {英会話|えいかいわ}のレッスン: English conversation lessons
- ダンスレッスン: dance lessons

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {授業|じゅぎょう}: class, lesson (school context)
- {稽古|けいこ}: practice, training (traditional arts)
